result.summary: The image shows a commercial urban intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and wide sidewalks. Pedestrian signals and traffic lights are present, but the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Pedestrian exposure
hazards.description: A pedestrian is visible in the roadway, and the crossing distance is relatively wide without intermediate protection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a raised crosswalk to physically slow vehicles approaching the pedestrian crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide commercial street with multi-lane traffic and a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a refuge island increase exposure risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large orange truck is stopped near the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crossing area could pose a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and stopping within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with sidewalks and marked crosswalks in a commercial area. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing their time in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are somewhat thin and may not be highly visible to approaching drivers compared to high-visibility patterns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a well-developed urban intersection with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, dedicated bus/bike lanes, and wide sidewalks. While pedestrian signals and clear lane markings are present, the lack of physical refuge islands or curb extensions leaves pedestrians exposed across multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Shared Bus/Bike Lane Conflict
hazards.description: The red-painted lane is shared by buses and cyclists, which can create unpredictable movements near the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, painted red

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing turn-related conflicts.

interventions.description: Add a raised island between the general traffic lane and the bus lane to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.
